# Visual workspace dependencies

Pinned browser distributions, downloaded 2026-10-06 from the npm registry. No build or runtime package installation is required. Marked parses saved Markdown; DOMPurify sanitizes it before an opaque sandbox renders it. The Marked distribution retains its upstream UMD contents under a stable asset name.
